items.title: Walmart stock sinks despite guidance raise, plans to ease prices with tariff refund
items.summary: Walmart stock (WMT) is dropping in Thursday's pre-market trading after releasing second quarter earnings results, outlining slowing sales growth despite the chain topping estimates and raising its full-year guidance. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian and POLITICO senior reporter Sam Sutton to talk about Walmart's outlook and its plans to use its tariff refunds to lower prices.

items.title: US Debt Just Hit $40 Trillion and the 30-Year Yield Is Still Above 5%: Why Buffett’s Berkshire Owns Businesses, Not Bonds
items.summary: Federal debt just crossed a staggering new threshold while Treasury scrambles to prop up the bond market, and the intervention collapsed within 24 hours. Where Berkshire puts its money instead reveals something most retirees holding long bonds have not yet reckoned with.

items.title: Which Airline Stock Is Dominating in 2026: United, American, or Delta?
items.summary: Three major airlines flew the same turbulent skies in 2026, yet their stock performance landed in completely different places. The reason comes down to one structural advantage that only one carrier built into its business model before fuel prices started climbing.

items.title: Berkshire Rebalances Portfolio: Is It Embracing the Tech Era?
items.summary: BRK.B boosts Alphabet, Delta and Lennar stakes while trimming several holdings as it reshapes its equity portfolio.

items.title: 1 Growth Stock Set to Flourishand 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Growth is a hallmark of all great companies, but the laws of gravity eventually take hold. Those who rode the COVID boom and ensuing tech selloff in 2022 will surely remember that the market’s punishment can be swift and severe when trajectories fall.

items.title: Marti Technologies Shares Rise After Revenue Beat and Higher Guidance
items.summary: Marti Technologies, Inc. (AMEX:MRT) shares gained 5% in pre-market trading on Wednesday after the Turkish mobility super app delivered second-quarter revenue well above expectations and raised its full-year outlook, despite reporting a wider-than-expected adjusted loss per share.

items.title: Is American Express’ Expanded Virtual Cards Strategy Deepening Its Corporate Moat In Premium Payments (AXP)?
items.summary: American Express recently expanded its Virtual Card capabilities for U.S. commercial customers, allowing them to create, manage, and use Amex Virtual Cards directly within the @ Work platform and via Conferma for Business Travel Account users, aiming to streamline payment processes, enhance security controls, and support a wide range of business spending needs. This move underscores how American Express is embedding its payment tools deeper into corporate finance and travel workflows,...

items.title: Berkshire Boosts Alphabet Stake 83% as Buffett Makes Major AI Bet
items.summary: Berkshire increased its Alphabet holding to nearly 106 million shares worth $37.8 billion.
